text: Done at 50c4070d. Encoders for all formats (ITK text/MATLAB, FLIRT, aff12, LTA, xfm, register.dat, NIfTI vector fields via float64 NiftiWriter) plus JVM Hdf5Writers (ITK HDF5, X5 via jHDF). RoundTripSuite loads every oracle file with TransformFiles and checks decode.encode.decode value-exactness for all 12 formats (NIfTI fields compared field by field: shape, codes, intent params, qform/sform, every value). Lexical exactness not claimed. Displacement writers for ANTs 5D LPS, AFNI, FSL relative/absolute delivered in Conversion (P5.02).
